Customer Response Desk · Private pilot by Aditya Pawade.
Data & pilot limits

Only approved team accounts can access saved cases. Files are read in your browser; valid rows are saved only after you choose Import. No email replies or scheduled reminders are sent. Updates require the latest case version. Reload or refresh to see other team members’ changes. There is no automatic live refresh. Case history is retained, with database revision timestamps. Keep testing with fictional data until the team has reviewed the workflow, retention and backup arrangements. Supabase JS licence · SheetJS licence.
